calm.text: The water climbs one floor every night.

whisper.text: Then the rope in the shaft started to move.

urgent.text: You told me to lock the closet and eat, so I did.

warm.text: For the first time in two days, his tail was wagging.

tense.text: It wasn't hiding in the closet, it was using it.

curious.text: One of you asked, if they had food, why not send some with the note?

dread.text: And from far below, something was climbing.
